name: metadata-merges-last-write-wins
description: metadata from every event of a text message merges into it key by key, last write winning, and the merge does not recurse
kill: fix a message's metadata at TEXT_MESSAGE_START instead of merging each event's, or make the merge recurse into a key's value

dotnet.intentional: Message metadata is a wire-level field in .NET: TEXT_MESSAGE_START and TEXT_MESSAGE_END yield no ChatResponseUpdate, so there is no merged metadata on the conversation surface to test last-write-wins against. Deliberate and documented in docs/concepts/metadata.mdx.
